text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft put on a stellar performance 
in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Her run left 
the spectators in sheer awe, changing 
their whole perception of Tiara Umamusume.

With all eyes upon her, Rhein Kraft 
announced that she would be running in the 
Victoria Mile.

Hearing the entry announcement, Sweep 
Tosho pouts in frustration. Unable to race 
due to injury, she demands that someone go 
out there and beat Rhein Kraft for her.

We've shone as Tiara Umamusume all this 
time. So leaving the future of the Tiara 
solely to Line Craft just isn't right.

If everyone runs together, we can cast an 
even more amazing magic. As the Victoria 
Mile approaches, she speaks these words.
